subject.title: TUI: Support Shift+Enter for newline (Enter to send)

question: Should this issue be narrowed to documenting the existing pi-tui multiline shortcuts, or should OpenClaw add a first-class configurable TUI send/newline keybinding surface?
rationale: Current main already supports newline insertion through pi-tui, but configurable Enter/Ctrl+Enter/Shift+Enter behavior would add a user-facing config or CLI contract that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Document Existing Behavior First
options.body: Update the TUI docs and /help with Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and backslash-enter fallback while deferring configurable keybindings until a config shape is approved.

options.title: Add Configurable TUI Keybindings
options.body: Introduce a maintainer-approved config or CLI bridge into pi-tui keybindings with tests for default compatibility and alternate send/newline modes.

options.title: Close As Partial Implementation
options.body: Close if maintainers consider dependency-backed Shift+Enter support sufficient and do not want docs/help or configurable keybinding work tracked here.

recommendation.title: Document Existing Behavior First
recommendation.body: Update the TUI docs and /help with Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and backslash-enter fallback while deferring configurable keybindings until a config shape is approved.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already mapped the remaining scope and current history ties him to the TUI editor/docs surfaces.
